description.en: Bahtera is a company profile website for manufacturers, oil and gas suppliers, and industrial distributors: present product lines and an equipment catalogue, explain the sourcing process, show certifications and project references, and collect quotation requests.
description.id: Bahtera adalah website profil perusahaan untuk manufaktur, pemasok migas, dan distributor industri: sajikan lini produk dan katalog peralatan, jelaskan proses pengadaan, tampilkan sertifikasi dan referensi proyek, lalu kumpulkan permintaan penawaran.
